meta.title: Task calendar
meta.description: Local task calendar, Pomodoro timer and review: projects with editing, archiving and milestones, task categories and colored checkboxes, task lists, Kanban board, week/month/day calendar, urgent/important matrix, content-aware KISS retrospective, free-form reflections, a 48-cell daily time strip, subtask checklists, focus statistics, configurable day-view hours, read-only macOS Calendar event sync, and today’s tasks plus review (focus time, Pomodoro count, KISS retrospective and reflections) written to a local Obsidian daily note. All data stays in local SQLite.
